social_circle.name: Tiana Roberts

demographics.occupation: part-time retail associate and prospective community college student

background.how_they_met: They met in high school in Orangeburg and became close through school, art, music, and late-night conversations.
background.why_close: Tiana is Lashonda's main peer confidante, the first person Lashonda sends photos to before posting, and someone she calls when stressed.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts almost every day, often in quick bursts with slang, reaction emojis, screenshots, and honest check-ins. She is more expressive than Lashonda and will nudge her to stop overthinking.

shared_activities: walking downtown while Lashonda takes photos
sitting in a car talking after choir
recent_text_topics: Reviewing Lashonda's street photos before Instagram posts.
College planning stress, scholarship deadlines, and whether Lashonda is being too hard on herself.
Music, family stress, church gossip, and jokes about needing coffee after long volunteer days.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 explicitly says, 'My best friend is Tiana,' and that they 'text almost every day.' Q39 says Lashonda copes through 'calling Tiana.' Q49 lists Tiana as a private support source.

social_circle.name: Denise Brazzell

demographics.education: High school diploma and some community college classes

background.how_they_met: Denise is Lashonda's mother and has raised her in Orangeburg in a church-centered, working-class family household.
background.why_close: Lashonda goes to Denise when overwhelmed because Denise listens, helps her break problems into next steps, and keeps track of family needs.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Uses clear, practical texts with full sentences or short checklists. She asks direct questions like where Lashonda is, whether she ate, and what the next step is.

shared_activities: college planning at the kitchen table
recent_text_topics: Scholarship deadlines, application paperwork, and reminders to keep everything in one planner.
Safety texts about where Lashonda is when walking or carrying her camera.
Household errands, groceries, dinner plans, and whether Lashonda has had water during busy days.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Lashonda's mother Denise is the person she talks to when overwhelmed. Q09 says Lashonda texts her mama where she is for safety. Q44 describes Denise helping after a missed scholarship deadline. Q103 identifies Denise's school office work.

social_circle.name: Malik Brazzell

background.how_they_met: Malik is Lashonda's younger brother, raised in the same Orangeburg household.
background.why_close: They share a home, and Lashonda helps him with homework, makes him playlists, and plays basketball with him at the church gym.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in short messages, memes, and requests. He is likely to send 'wyd,' homework photos, basketball reminders, and jokes instead of long paragraphs.

shared_activities: Saturday basketball at the church gym
recent_text_topics: Asking Lashonda for help with writing assignments or whether a paragraph sounds right.
Checking if the church gym is open for basketball on Saturday.
Sending game clips, playlist ideas, and jokes when he wants attention instead of doing homework.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Malik is 14, Lashonda helps him with schoolwork, makes playlists, and they shoot basketball at the church gym. Q15 and Q19 also describe her helping Malik after school.

social_circle.name: Anthony Brazzell

demographics.education: High school diploma and maintenance-related technical training

background.how_they_met: Anthony is Lashonda's father and has lived with her throughout her childhood and young adulthood.
background.why_close: He is quieter than Denise but steady, practical, and important because Lashonda depends on family transportation and respects his reliability.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Brief, functional texts with few extras. He sends timing updates, ride confirmations, and practical reminders rather than emotional paragraphs.

shared_activities: practical advice around safety and transportation
recent_text_topics: Whether he can give Lashonda a ride to the museum, church, library, or an appointment.
Car trouble worries and gas or timing logistics for family errands.
Checking in after evening events or when she is walking with her camera.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Anthony is Lashonda's father, is steady, and helps with rides when his schedule allows. Q08 and Q79 show transportation is a major constraint. Q106-Q107 describe his maintenance work.

social_circle.name: Pearl Brazzell

demographics.occupation: retired church volunteer and family elder

background.how_they_met: Pearl is Lashonda's grandmother and has been part of her life since childhood, especially through church and family storytelling.
background.why_close: Pearl keeps family stories alive and connects Lashonda to Orangeburg history, church memory, and older relatives' experiences.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts shorter messages, often with greetings, blessings, reminders, and occasional voice calls when a story is too long to type.

shared_activities: visits once or twice a week
recent_text_topics: Sunday dinner plans, church service details, and whether Lashonda is coming by.
Family stories connected to Orangeburg history and civil rights memory.
Health check-ins about blood pressure, arthritis, groceries, and appointment reminders.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 names grandmother Pearl as important and says Lashonda sees her once or twice a week. Q05 and Q30 say Pearl keeps family stories alive and connects events to older Orangeburg and civil rights stories. Q35 mentions Pearl's high blood pressure and arthritis.
